author: Inside Edition
description: It started as a fun day out on the water for two foil surfers off California's Santa Barbara coast. But the outing turned terrifying as they were chased by what they think was a great white shark for miles. They spoke with Inside Edition's Jim Moret about their nail-biting scare at sea.
title: Shark Pursues Surfers For Miles In Terrifying Chase

author: Inside Edition
description: An explosion sent several NYPD officers to the hospital during an early morning call. Officials say it happened when officers were responding to a house in Queens that called 911 regarding a domestic dispute with a weapon involved. Officers were trying to get into the home when it exploded. Even though they were injured, some officers still went into the house after hearing children crying. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Several NYPD Officers Injured In House Explosion

author: Inside Edition
description: A man attacked another man with a cleaver in an office and it was all caught on surveillance cameras. Turkish media released a video showing the suspect approaching a man sitting at a desk in a municipal office. The suspect slowly creeps around the desk and stops next to it. That's when he appears to pull something out of his coat. Once he raises the object, it's clear that it's a cleaver. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Man Attacks Office Worker With Cleaver

author: Inside Edition
description: They call her the Jump Rope Queen, because at age 82, Annie Judis can beat girls young enough to be her great grandchildren. The Beverly Hills, California octogenarian even landed herself in the record books. The former actress and model holds a Guinness World Record for being the oldest competitive rope skipper. Judis also loves to share her routines on Instagram. Inside Edition's Alison Hall has more on this inspiring senior.
title: Octogenarian Is A 'Jump Rope Queen'
